Aircraft Performance Engineer (d/f/m)

Getafe Area · Full time · Posted 4 Days Ago · Job requisition ID JR10433452
Apply

Job Description

The Flight Physics Centre of Competence (CoC) is a German-Spanish organisation within Airbus Defence & Space Engineering, responsible for flight physics deliverables for all fixed-wing aircraft programmes. Its capabilities cover Aerodynamics; Aircraft Performance & Mass Properties; Static Loads, Structural Dynamics & Acoustics; and Flight Dynamics & Flight Control Laws.

For current and future challenges in the Aircraft Performance & Mass Properties domain, Airbus is looking for a new candidate to join the Aircraft Performance team. The engineer reports to the Head of Aircraft Performance and is accountable for Aircraft Performance deliverables for all AD&S fixed-wing programs.

Competences and operational accountability

  • Be accountable for performance activities supporting programs, R&D/T, certification and negotiations with certification authorities.
  • Support the design phase of future programs and derivatives.
  • Evaluate the performance impact of aircraft and engine configuration changes.
  • Carry out studies for sales campaigns, RFPs and customer enquiries.
  • Support customer-services flight operations, operational tools, documentation, computerized operating data and in-service queries.
  • Support flight-data analysis for development, certification, training and incident investigations.
  • Implement roadmaps for tools, data management and Aircraft Performance services.
  • Ensure quality and clarity of technical dossiers and implement digitalization, capability and technology roadmaps.
  • Contribute to transversal activities, synergies and continuous process improvement.

Skills & Experience

  • Minimum Master’s degree in Aeronautical Engineering.
  • 3–5 years of Aircraft Performance experience in development, flight test and certification.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and an owner mentality.
  • Ability to think strategically, execute methodically and work under pressure.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, conflict-management and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to travel as required.
  • English at negotiation level; German or Spanish preferred.

This job requires awareness of compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity.
